import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
  {"name": "C", "kind": "char"},
  {"name": "S3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
  {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b"]},
  {"name": "P", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f", "U8"], ["g", "B"]]},
  {"name": "AliasP", "kind": "alias", "target": "P"},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "U8", "size": 2},
]
modules = [
  {"name": "top", "params": [["a", "AliasP"], ["s", "S3"], ["e", "E"], ["arr", "Arr"], ["c", "C"]],
   "result": ["out", "B"], "requires": None},
]
# a: x0(struct) x1(f) x2(g); s: x3 buffer, x4 x5 x6 chars; e: x7; arr: x8, x9 x10; c: x11; result out: x12
objects = [obj("x1", 5, 1), obj("x2", 1, 1),
           obj("x4", ord('a'), 1), obj("x5", 0, 1), obj("x6", ord('z'), 1),
           obj("x7", 1, 4), obj("x9", 1, 1), obj("x10", 2, 1), obj("x11", 200, 1),
           obj("x12", 1, 1)]
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["top"],
       "machine": None, "runs": [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects)}]}
got = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(got["records"], indent=1))
print(json.dumps(got["corpus"], indent=1))
assert got["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"a": {"f": 5, "g": True}, "s": "a", "e": "b", "arr": [1, 2], "c": "È"}, got["corpus"]
assert got["records"][0] == {"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": True}
print("PASS value recovery / NUL truncation / char 200")

# string with no NUL: all maxsize bytes
objects2 = [obj("x1", 0, 1), obj("x2", 0, 1),
            obj("x4", ord('a'), 1), obj("x5", ord('b'), 1), obj("x6", ord('c'), 1),
            obj("x7", 0, 4), obj("x9", 0, 1), obj("x10", 0, 1), obj("x11", 0, 1),
            obj("x12", 0, 1)]
doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects2)}]
got = run(doc)
assert got["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["s"] == "abc", got["corpus"]
print("PASS full string")

# duplicate identity: same inputs but different result -> DUPLICATE
doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects)}, {"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects2[:9] + [obj("x12", 0, 1)])}]

print(json.dumps(got["records"]))
